title: 12 Best Vegan Restaurants in Almaty
description: Discover the top 12 vegan restaurants in Almaty, Kazakhstan. From healthy cafes to budget-friendly eats and international flavors, find your next plant-based meal in Almaty.

places.name: Green House (Зеленый Дом)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Vegan Burger with Sweet Potato Fries or their signature Green House Salad

places.name: Veggie Food (Вегги Фуд)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Lentil Soup and any of their daily 'kotlety' (vegan patties) with a side of steamed vegetables.

places.name: Govinda's
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Thali' plate – a generous sampler of various curries, rice, bread, and often a dessert, ask for the vegan version.

places.name: Namaste
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Aloo Gobi (potato and cauliflower curry) and Chana Masala (chickpea curry) with vegan roti or rice.

places.name: Freshman Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Acai Bowl with your choice of toppings or a Custom Vegan Salad with their homemade dressings.

places.name: Nedelka Cafe & Store
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Seasonal Vegetable Tart (check for vegan crust) or a bespoke salad from their deli counter, specifying vegan ingredients.

places.name: Eat Happy
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Raw Vegan Lasagna and any of their beautifully crafted raw cheesecakes or energy balls.

places.name: Urban Coffee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any coffee with oat or almond milk, and look for their vegan brownie or avocado toast (confirm no butter/cheese).

places.name: Marmalade Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Vegetable sandwich (ask for no cheese, vegan bread) or a fresh fruit salad. Inquire about their daily vegan soup.

places.name: The Burger Lab (T.B.L.)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Vegan Lab Burger' – a well-crafted patty with fresh toppings and vegan sauce, often served with fries.

places.name: Bloom Coffee & Tea
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pour-over coffee with oat milk and ask about their current vegan muffin or cookie offerings.

places.name: Shafran
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Lentil Soup (Adas Shorva), Hummus with pita bread (confirm vegan bread), and their selection of fresh salads.
